name: com.bovinelabs.timeline.particles
description:
A BovineLabs DOTS Timeline track that drives Unity ParticleSystem (Shuriken) effects on companion GameObjects.

The Play Particle System track binds a ParticleSystem (a baked companion entity). On a clip's start it restarts the system from the beginning (Clear + Play, optionally with all child systems for composite effects), and on the clip's end it stops it. Unlike the GameObjects Activation track, re-entering a clip replays the effect from the start instead of leaving a finished/composite particle system in its completed state.
